name: Bolt Forge
tagline: Bolt's new agent with open-source models and 50X usage
description: Bolt Forge is a new agent inside Bolt.new that runs on open-source models. Every Pro plan gets up to 50X more usage with no daily caps. Scores 91% of Bolt's top paid model on their internal benchmark.

name: Mantra Timer
tagline: A minimalist mantra meditation timer for iOS.
description: Mantra Meditation Timer rejects the bloated tracking of modern wellness apps. Built for self-directed practitioners, this elegant iOS app offers a distraction-free experience with zero data collection. Enjoy core Meditation timers, calming chimes, and mental or physical check-ins completely free. For established pro mantra practitioners, a small one-off payment unlocks advanced stats and deeper customisation. No subscription fatigue, just a beautifully simple tool for profound daily practice.

name: Lumiko
tagline: Screen recordings that edit themselves with Auto Zoom-Pan
description: Lumiko records your screen and edits the footage while you work. It tracks your cursor and clicks, then builds smooth zoom and pan moves over them automatically, no keyframes. Trim, split, and reorder clips on a timeline right in the browser. Smart Blur hides API keys and passwords in one drag. Add a webcam bubble, custom backgrounds, click effects. Exports up to 4K. Runs locally, no account, no upload queue. Free to start.

name: Steam Frame
tagline: Your Steam library, now on a wearable PC
description: Steam Frame is a wireless SteamOS headset that streams your whole library from a PC, Deck, or Machine, and runs standalone titles too. Dual radios plus an included adapter keep streaming stable. The controllers work as VR wands and a full gamepad.

name: Lull
tagline: Tell it what is on your mind. It writes the meditation.
description: Lull doesn't play recordings. Talk for a minute about what's actually going on and it writes a meditation for that moment, read in one of 11 voices. Oura recovery shapes the tone. Apple Watch records your heart rate and shows the real settle after, or nothing.

name: Squirrel
tagline: An app blocker that pays you back
description: Squirrel puts a price on the apps you open too much. Tap Instagram and you get a hard block, not a screen you can wave away. Want to check a DM? That's fine, but you have to open Squirrel, pick how long, and set aside a few dollars for yourself first. No money moves through the app. No card or bank account to connect. When you're ready, invest it in your own brokerage and tell Squirrel what you bought. It tracks your holdings with live prices.

name: Doneit 3.2
tagline: Reimagined Doneit Assist, support for Siri AI, and more
description: You can now attach photos when planning tasks with Doneit Assist to turn a handwritten list, whiteboard or a document into tasks, include additional details to make tasks more accurate, as well as let it suggest reminders and attributes for tasks, and break tasks into subtasks. Doneit Assist can now also create a brief summary of a task list, highlight its key tasks for you to focus on, as well as show the upcoming tasks in this list.

name: VoiceCap
tagline: The AI notetaker for meetings in your language
description: Most AI notetakers are strong in English and mediocre in everything else. VoiceCap transcribes in 100+ languages and writes the summary, action items and decisions in that same language. Record in the room via native apps, send a bot to Zoom, Meet or Teams, or upload a file. Every meeting becomes a searchable record of what was decided and who owns it. Ask Claude or ChatGPT about it over MCP. EU company, recordings stored in Frankfurt, never used to train models. 300 free minutes, no card.

name: Ruby UTCP
tagline: The scalable, secure alternative to MCP for tool calling
description: Ruby UTCP brings UTCP 1.1 to Ruby, giving apps and AI agents a standard way to discover and call tools over native protocols. It supports 12 transports, including HTTP, CLI, WebSocket, gRPC, GraphQL, MCP and WebRTC, plus streaming, auth, OpenAPI discovery, and CodeMode for programmable multi-tool workflows. Open source and built for the Ruby ecosystem.

name: Basedash Models
tagline: Define it once. Query it like a table.
description: Basedash Models is a semantic workspace of reusable, governed SQL for core business concepts—customers, orders, active accounts—so everyone works from the same trusted definition. Each model has dedicated views for details, columns, measures, and segments, plus synonyms, row grain, relationships, and usage guidance the assistant reads when it answers. Reference a model in SQL like a table: select * from models.customers. Define it once. Query it like a table.

name: Punch
tagline: Save your group chat's important stuff
description: You’re on vacation with your friends and you need to know the AirBnB address, the door code, the rendezvous spot, etc. Instead of scrolling through 100+ messages, save all that info on Punch and share with your friends and family. Why we're different: Notes App: This can fill up quick and can look clunky after a while. You also can’t share individual pieces from a note. Also, incompatibility between OS. Drive/Dropbox/etc.: Has the storage/shareability aspect, but is more geared toward storage.

name: Mise
tagline: The meal planner that gets all your dishes ready at once
description: Recipes help you cook one dish. But meals have multiple dishes! Mise schedules every dish backwards from the minute you want to eat: one start time, one running order, a merged shopping list, a cooking mode. That way you get everything ready at the right time and can work from a simple prep list that includes ingredients, instructions, and reminders. Free with no login.

name: BiBimba
tagline: Clipboard history that can read your screenshots
description: Clipboard history and screenshots, searchable together. BiBimba reads the text inside screenshots, so you can find a receipt total or an error message later and paste just what you need. On-device AI translates, summarizes, rewrites. Stays on your Mac. $9.

name: Lappka
tagline: Turn app screens into an App Store screenshots that converts
description: Lappka helps mobile makers turn raw app screens into a conversion-focused App Store screenshots. Use AI for strategy and copy, then make every detail yours with editable templates, localization, App Store preview, and ready-to-export screenshots.

name: Globenomics
tagline: Explore 3D globe, 16 games, and 195 countries up for auction
description: 16 geography games on a fully explorable 3D globe. Speedrun 195 countries, match capitals, guess flags, duel a friend and more Games pay you in GlobeMillions, and countries go to auction. Win one and you hold it for 24 hours: your avatar and name on that country, plus a note and one link to promote something, moderated before anyone sees it. Hold it longest, you're Country King. Click any country for GDP and wages, billionaires, unicorns, taxes, passport power, the Big Mac index and many more

name: NotchOwl
tagline: Turn your Mac’s notch into a sleek productivity workspace.
description: Tasks, notes, focus timers, and calendar events in your Mac’s notch. One hover away.

name: LucentraCode
tagline: Code without the Clock
description: LucentraCode is an AI coding CLI built for developers who want powerful models without constantly worrying about usage limits or expensive subscriptions. Run it directly from your terminal, choose from models like GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, and more, and use them for real development work - debugging, building features, refactoring, testing, and working across larger codebases.

name: One More Thing
tagline: Turn doomscrolling into something worth knowing.
description: One More Thing turns curiosity into a habit. Instead of endless scrolling through content you’ll forget, choose something you want to know and learn it one card at a time. Explore psychology, history, science, money, culture, languages, weird facts, and more. Every topic becomes a bite-sized learning deck you can swipe through in minutes. Earn XP, build streaks, unlock badges, and discover something new every day. Scroll less. Know more. There’s always One More Thing.

name: Made with Jev
tagline: What people are building on Jev
description: Jev by TypeSafe is the new AI model that makes decisions instead of writing text, in under half a second. I'm building a directory to share all Jev related resources. Explore the insane things people built with it: browser agents, games, email triage, viral tweet analyzers. Each with its real cost. Plus a free AI slop detector and other tools coming.

name: IronFuel for Android
tagline: Now on Android: log a set, watch today's food target move
description: Android lifters have been running a gym log and a calorie app that ignore each other. IronFuel joins them: log sets in three taps or by voice, photograph a meal, and when a session ends the day's calorie and protein target moves to match what you burned.
